notes:
CRM notes and quick fragments from calls and POC.
- Quick background: mid-market product analytics SaaS (user-facing recommendations + search).
- Primary ask: production-grade embeddings pipeline + semantic search hybrid ranking.
- Quote from Emily Cho (Product): "Need interactive recommend latency; ideally <120ms per embed call for UX. Nightly backfill of ~10M rows is non-negotiable."
- Current stack: Postgres + S3 for source; evaluating Pinecone for vector storage but team worried about egress costs and multi-region replication.
- Preference: start on Hosted API to move fast, then commit to Dedicated if we can hit cost/throughput targets and have VPC options.
- Cost sensitivity: wants unit cost per 1536-d embed under $0.0008 for batch runs; interactive calls tolerate higher but need latency guarantees.
- Integration asks: direct connector to Pinecone/Milvus or ability to export embeddings to S3 for batch ingestion.
- Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, KMS key wrap, audit log delivery to their SIEM. Data residency: US-only for product data (legal).
- POC scope agreed: 1) hosted small slice (50k rows) to validate latency & API ergonomics; 2) nightly batch test (500k -> 10M rows) to measure throughput & cost; 3) integration test with Pinecone/managed Milvus via customer test cluster.
- AE notes: Jordan to circle back with pricing scenarios for Hosted vs Dedicated commit levels. SE Maya to write batching recommendations (chunk size, concurrency).

use_case_summary: Embedding-driven personalization + semantic product search. Requirements: interactive embed latency <120ms median for UI, nightly batch of up to 10M new/updated items, ability to store vectors in preferred vector DB (customer evaluating Pinecone/Milvus), deterministic cost profile for finance. Also want auto-batching suggestions and quantization recommendations for cost reduction.
poc_results_highlights: Hosted API (small slice): median embed latency 140ms (need <120ms) - worse in some regions.
Batch run (500k sample): sustained 300 embeds/sec using 8 concurrent workers - target is to hit 2k+ for night window.
Search trial: semantic recall good on small data; end-to-end index+query latency ~220ms with Pinecone sandbox.
Security: SOC2 docs provided; legal raised data residency clause for US-only storage.
